items.title: Show HN: Inbox Cleanup – get to inbox zero in Gmail
items.contentSnippet:
We've been working on a small tool that can help with huge (or really, any size) Gmail inboxes. It's meant for people who have let their inbox grow for years and don't know where to start.
We had this idea after talking to a lot of people about how they use their email, and one thing that kept coming up was how hard it is to keep up when you receive a lot of emails. Things pile up and cleaning up starts to feel impossible.
One important detail: the tool never performs any destructive operations

items.title: Show HN: Walk the Endless Dungeon
items.contentSnippet:
Small fun experiment to tinker with "wave function collapse" for infinite, organic feeling, maze generation. Then I wanted a way to have the same generation every time for a given seed, while still being explorable infinitely. So I merge a seed-based priority assignment and zone interface and then resolve the inside of a zone using WFC.
Those places can be walked infinitely with infinite levels up and down.
Probably just me, but it calms my nerves to roam those digital corridors.

items.contentSnippet:
